ModMetaData.name: 8-Bit Performance Mode
ModMetaData.author: YewChicken
ModMetaData.description:
Low performance mode for low-end hardware. Downscales world textures at load time (and optionally reduces color depth) to cut memory use and give the game a chunky retro look. UI textures are left alone.
Presets: Off, Half, Quarter, 8-bit, 4-bit. Changing the preset requires a game restart.
